comment: The dotnet/runtime state Styml contains. Written by eng/upstream/sync when a sync is committed; eng/upstream/check fails if UPSTREAM.md disagrees. See docs/upstream-sync.md.

follow.comment: The upstream line the sync follows. 'servicing' (the default) and 'major' take 'tags', a regular expression on tag names whose highest matching version is the target; 'main' takes 'ref', a branch. docs/upstream-sync.md describes the choice.
